doc: Stub-first conformance vectors for the studio contract. The fixture server must pass these before the SE-08 host lands; when SE-08 lands, the same vectors run against the real host (DB-02 acceptance: the fixture passes the same conformance vectors stub-first).

vectors.expect: HTTP 200; response envelope v=2, op echoes 'engine.status', correlationId echoes the request; result has engineId, engineVersion, role in {single,leader,follower}, startedAt ISO-8601, uptimeMs >= 0, storage{collections,documents,walBytes}, counters{reads,writes,queries,familyOperations}
HTTP 200; response correlationId equals the request correlationId exactly
HTTP 404; typed error envelope v=2 with error.code 'operation.unknown' and retryable false
HTTP 400; typed error envelope with error.code 'protocol.version-unsupported' — fail closed on unknown envelope version
HTTP 400; typed error envelope with error.code 'protocol.envelope-invalid' — op must match the route segment
HTTP 200; QueryResult with matched > 0, rows[].document typed DocumentRecord, staleness array present
first frames are session.opened then subscription.established; both carry v=2, a valid sha256 digest over their payload, and monotonic seq; subscription.established payload carries a checkpoint
delta frames carry strictly increasing seq, seq matches payload.seq, digest recomputes over the payload, and no frame carries credentials or cross-tenant data
within the observation window at least one heartbeat frame with a valid digest is delivered

after the fixture drops the connection, a reconnect presenting Last-Event-ID '<sessionId>:<seq>' replays exactly the missed deltas with their original seq identities (no gaps, no duplicates beyond at-least-once identities)
a reconnect presenting an unknown or evicted checkpoint receives a resync.required frame with reason and lastSeq — never a silent partial replay
the fixture can emit one frame with an unknown type ('bogus.frame') under fixture control so clients prove fail-closed rejection (counted, surfaced, connection retained or re-established)
HTTP 400; typed error envelope with error.code 'family.kind-unknown' — the closed FamilyKind set fails closed
HTTP 200; FamilyReadResult echoes kind 'counters' and scope 'studio' with a typed state object

under fixture control 'session-gate': HTTP 401; typed error envelope with error.code 'session.unauthenticated', retryable false, and error.loginUrl pointing at the host's (simulated) login flow, which answers 200 — the studio's session bootstrap redirects there; when the control resets to the default ungated behavior, engine.status answers 200 again
